description: This Python source file provides utility functions for determining platform-specific user and system directories, such as data, config, cache, and media directories, using a platform-aware class called PlatformDirs. It includes functions that generate paths for various user and system directories across different platforms, allowing for consistent directory location resolution in a cross-platform manner.

classes.name: PlatformDirs
classes.description: A platform-specific class instance that provides various directory paths tailored to the user's platform.
